fact: On 22 September 2026 the Prime Minister said Lesotho's UN AI Strategy Blueprint work produced a roadmap of five actions each assigned to responsible institutions with timelines, and that Phase One of the National Compute Roadmap 2026-2029 is being implemented.
title: Opening remarks by the Right Honourable Prime Minister Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane at the Second UN Digital Cooperation Day 2025 in New York
publisher: Government of Lesotho, Department of Information
